payload.heading: Momentum, with room to compound.
payload.hook: If you remember one thing: growth is no longer the constraint. Supply is.
payload.summary: Atlas spent Q3 proving that fleet analytics sells itself, and Q4 proving it can be delivered. Revenue, retention and runway all moved the right way at once, which is rare enough to be worth naming. The pressure has moved downstream: actuator lead times and senior robotics hiring now decide how much of that demand actually converts.
payload.byline: Prepared by A. Rathore · Reviewed by Finance · July 2026

entries.label: ARR

entries.label: Net retention
entries.implication: Existing customers expand faster than new ones arrive, which favours depth over reach

entries.implication: There is room to hire ahead of revenue rather than behind it

entries.label: Headcount
entries.implication: Hiring is keeping pace everywhere except senior robotics

entries.consequence: Gross margin erodes exactly as volume arrives
